info.description: Apply property V35 and notification V4 before deploying. Deploy notification consumer before enabling producer delivery. Pause publishing while upgrading producer instances; resume after all instances are updated. Enable ALERTS_ENABLED and ALERTS_PUBLISHER_ENABLED; run RabbitMQ and both services. The first evaluation is silent. Consecutive frozen published USD estimates are compared, not sale prices. Thresholds are inclusive and are checked before rounding; supported and limited values are eligible, unsupported/missing values rebaseline. A saved-search rule baselines newly entering properties silently. Pause/resume and criteria/filter changes reset valuation baselines and cancel pending outdated valuation events. No historical values are recalculated. Use a test database for synthetic model publications.
info.name: SCRUM-151 Valuation change alerts

request.description: 202. Poll monitoring until BASELINED/COMPLETED. Requires enabled monitoring and an unpaused owned rule. Paused/disabled/unsupported listing source returns 409. No body.

First scan BASELINED with no event. After a qualifying new Python publication, schedule again: COMPLETED and pending/sent count increases. Unchanged estimate, wrong direction or sub-threshold changes produce no event.
Use the same recipient access_token. A delivered event creates one VALUATION_CHANGED notification with frozen old/new estimates. Duplicate RabbitMQ delivery must not create another.
Full replacement of preferences. Email additionally requires verified email in JWT and configured SES. Disabling VALUATION_CHANGED suppresses its notifications independently of NEW_MATCH.
